newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes down vs US dollar on correction.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes down vs US dollar on correction.

text.p: The Chinese yuan fell slightly to close at 8.2970 against the U.S. dollar on Friday from Thursday's 8.2967 on a technical correction after rises in the past four days, traders said.
The yuan opened higher at 8.2966 and consolidated around 8.2970 for most of the session, hitting an intra-day high of 8.2965 and a low of 8.2973.
Trading was dull, with most done at 8.2970, traders said.
Dealers said it was about time for a technical correction given the continuous rises of the past week.
"Some profit-taking selling before the weekend at higher levels capped the yuan's upward trend," one dealer said.
"Thin trading volume indicated most investors are taking a wait-and-see attitude and the potential for further rises is limited," he said.
Dealers expected the yuan to fall steadily early next week.
The yuan closed up at an intra-day high of 7.2550 from 7.2900 against 100 Japanese yen and down at 1.0726 from 1.0710 against the Hong Kong dollar.
